scope: Unmodified official signed Mac application, isolated synthetic pending approvals; production CardView/IPC/ApplicationService saves exact image grant. No live model, worker image execution or personal data modification.
checks: Keyboard approval through the signed application persists an exact image grant while another pending operation stays unapproved
Signed application restart retains the original grant and does not approve unrelated operations

observations: Dark 1280: exact image path, admission to current model, current Bot/tasks and 30-minute scope fit in one permission card; unrelated file-write request is a separate card.
Light 760: full path wraps within the card and all three choices remain visible without horizontal overflow.
